data.one_liner: A collection of 78 Islamic icons for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of pre-made Islamic-themed icons that can be used with the Icon widget. The icons are available as named constants in the FlutterIslamicIcons class.
use_when: You need Islamic-themed icons for a Flutter UI
You want a quick, no‑setup icon set without external assets
avoid_when: You require custom icon shapes or colors beyond the provided set
You need icons that adapt to themes or dynamic styling
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or codegen
weaknesses: No support for custom colors or sizes beyond Icon widget defaults
No theming or dynamic styling support
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a larger icon set and more customization options
